--- title: "Sensitivity Analyses" --- ## Comparison 1: CMV Sensitivity Analyses {#sec-sens-c1-cmv} Two pre-specified sensitivity analyses were conducted for CMV to address era effects and donor-type heterogeneity. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} sens_cmv <- do.call(rbind, list( or_summary(post_m1, "b_ptcy_binary", "Full corpus", model = "Primary (k=18)"), or_summary(post_m1_post2020, "b_ptcy_binary", "Post-2020", model = "Post-2020 (k=13)"), or_summary(post_m1_haplo, "b_ptcy_binary", "Haplo-only", model = "Haplo \u226550% (k=11)") )) |> as_tibble() |> mutate( model = factor(model, levels = rev(c("Primary (k=18)", "Post-2020 (k=13)", "Haplo \u226550% (k=11)"))), label = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", or, lo, hi) ) ggplot(sens_cmv, aes(x = or, y = model)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = jama_grey) + geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), colour = jama_navy, fill = jama_navy, shape = 16, size = 0.6, linewidth = 0.6) + geom_text(aes(x = hi, label = label), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.2, colour = jama_black) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.8, 3)) + scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 1.5, 2, 2.5)) + labs(x = "Odds Ratio (log scale)", y = NULL, title = "CMV Sensitivity — Comparison 1", subtitle = "Restricting to post-2020 or haplo-dominant studies strengthens the signal") + theme_jama() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![CMV sensitivity analyses (C1). Both restrictions strengthen the effect, consistent with (a) post-2020 letermovir-era prophylaxis widening the gap, and (b) haploidentical donor settings amplifying PTCy's T-cell depletion effect.](sensitivity_files/figure-html/fig-sens-c1-cmv-1.svg){#fig-sens-c1-cmv} ::: ::: | Analysis | k | OR [95% CrI] | P(OR > 1.5) | |---|---|---|---| | Full corpus | 18 | 1.41 [1.20–1.65] | 22% | | Post-2020 only | 13 | 1.80 [1.49–2.18] | 97% | | Haplo ≥50% | 11 | 1.70 [1.39–2.10] | 89% | ## Comparison 1: IFI Leave-One-Out {#sec-sens-c1-ifi} ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} if (is.data.frame(loo_tbl)) { loo_plot <- loo_tbl |> mutate(fmt_label = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", or_median, or_lo, or_hi), study = fct_reorder(label, or_median)) ggplot(loo_plot, aes(x = or_median, y = study)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = jama_grey) + geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = or_lo, xmax = or_hi), colour = jama_navy, size = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) + geom_text(aes(x = or_hi + 0.05, label = sprintf("\u03c4=%.2f", tau_median)), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.8, colour = jama_steel) + labs(x = "OR (IFI, PTCy vs CNI+MTX/MMF)", y = "Excluded study", title = "IFI Leave-One-Out — Comparison 1", subtitle = "\u03c4 values annotated; Yanada 2026 drives nearly all heterogeneity") + theme_jama() } else { cat("LOO table not available.") } ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Leave-one-out analysis for IFI (C1). Excluding Yanada 2026 (zero-event structural outlier) collapses τ from 1.05 to 0.38 while barely moving the OR. No other single study produces a comparable influence.](sensitivity_files/figure-html/fig-sens-ifi-loo-1.svg){#fig-sens-ifi-loo} ::: ::: ## Comparison 2: Expanded Arm Inclusion {#sec-sens-c2-arms} The primary C2 analysis excluded 12 arms (PTCy+ATG combo, mixed, neither). The sensitivity reclassifies PTCy+ATG as PTCy-side and mixed-ATG arms by PTCy co-administration status, adding 6 previously unpaired studies. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} sens_c2 <- do.call(rbind, list( or_summary(post_c2_os, "b_ptcy_binary", "OS", model = "Primary (k=10)"), or_summary(post_c2_sens_os, "b_ptcy_binary", "OS", model = "Sensitivity (k=11)"), or_summary(post_c2_agvhd, "b_ptcy_binary", "aGVHD", model = "Primary (k=6)"), or_summary(post_c2_sens_agvhd, "b_ptcy_binary", "aGVHD", model = "Sensitivity (k=8)"), or_summary(post_c2_cmv, "b_ptcy_binary", "CMV", model = "Primary (k=12)"), or_summary(post_c2_sens_cmv, "b_ptcy_binary", "CMV", model = "Sensitivity (k=14)") )) |> as_tibble() |> mutate( outcome = factor(outcome, levels = c("OS", "aGVHD", "CMV")), analysis = ifelse(grepl("Primary", model), "Primary", "Sensitivity"), label = sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", or, lo, hi) ) sens_c2 <- sens_c2 |> mutate( y_num = as.numeric(outcome) * 2, y_pos = y_num + ifelse(analysis == "Primary", 0.2, -0.2) ) ggplot(sens_c2, aes(x = or, y = y_pos, colour = analysis, shape = analysis)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = jama_grey) + geom_hline(yintercept = c(3, 5), colour = jama_light_grey, linewidth = 0.2) + geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), size = 0.5, linewidth = 0.5) + geom_text(aes(x = hi, label = label), hjust = -0.05, size = 2.8, colour = jama_black, show.legend = FALSE, nudge_y = 0.3) + scale_colour_manual(values = c("Primary" = jama_navy, "Sensitivity" = jama_steel)) + scale_shape_manual(values = c("Primary" = 16, "Sensitivity" = 17)) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(2, 4, 6), labels = c("OS", "aGVHD", "CMV")) + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.3, 1.5), ylim = c(0.8, 7.2)) + labs(x = "Odds Ratio", y = NULL, title = "Comparison 2 \u2014 Expanded Arm Sensitivity", subtitle = "Primary (circles) vs sensitivity with expanded arm inclusion (triangles)", colour = NULL, shape = NULL) + theme_jama() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Sensitivity analysis — expanded arm inclusion (C2). OS and aGVHD are robust; CMV attenuates notably (OR 0.77 → 0.91) because PTCy+ATG combination arms (reclassified as PTCy-side) carry higher CMV reactivation risk.](sensitivity_files/figure-html/fig-sens-c2-arms-1.svg){#fig-sens-c2-arms} ::: ::: ## Bayesian vs Frequentist Concordance {#sec-sens-freq} ::: {#tbl-freq-concordance .cell tbl-cap='Bayesian vs frequentist estimates across both comparisons. Agreement is generally good; OS C2 diverges due to small-study outliers regularised by the Bayesian τ prior.'} ```{.r .cell-code} tibble::tribble( ~Outcome, ~Comparison, ~`Bayes OR`, ~`Freq OR`, ~I2, ~Concordance, "OS", "C1", "0.77 [0.71-0.83]", "0.75 [0.63-0.89]", "68%", "Good", "OS", "C2", "0.69 [0.61-0.78]", "0.53 [0.29-0.96]", "90%", "Divergent*", "NRM", "C1", "0.86 [0.70-1.08]", "0.78 [0.56-1.09]", "39%", "Good", "NRM", "C2", "0.65 [0.43-0.97]", "0.61 [0.39-0.95]", "0%", "Good", "aGVHD","C1", "0.63 [0.54-0.74]", "0.55 [0.40-0.76]", "63%", "Good", "aGVHD","C2", "0.59 [0.42-0.84]", "0.44 [0.22-0.88]", "67%", "Moderate", "CMV", "C1", "1.41 [1.20-1.65]", "1.22 [0.87-1.71]", "69%", "Good", "CMV", "C2", "0.77 [0.60-0.99]", "0.67 [0.41-1.09]", "67%", "Good" ) |> kable(align = c("l","c","c","c","c","c")) |> kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE) |> footnote(symbol = "Driven by Dybko 2024 (OR 0.07) and Nykolyszyn 2020 (OR 0.17); Bayesian tau prior regularises these outliers.") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
